verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents a minutes-scale quickstart, a free no-credit-card tier, and per-environment (including production) flag enable/disable, plus a toggle endpoint. A community user reports getting a flag working in about 15 minutes, and a hands-on probe created and evaluated a flag end to end. missing for 10: hands-on evidence that a production toggle propagates live (the probe covered create-and-evaluate, not toggling), and real-time streaming of toggles is documented only for JavaScript/React via the Proxy.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create a feature flag and toggle it live in production within minutes of signing up

citations.quote: Get GrowthBook running in your application in minutes.
Use environments such as dev, staging, and production to enable or disable feature flags independently.
the toggle feature endpoint, which switches a flag on or off in one or more environments.
We had Growthbook working in roughly 15 minutes with under 10 lines of code changed.
a real flag create-and-evaluate loop with no account or license
